query: For a female COPD inpatient I'm evaluating, what's the maximum peak serum creatinine among hospitalized female COPD patients (mg/dL)?
final_sql: SELECT MAX(l.value) AS max_creatinine_level FROM labevents l JOIN patients p ON l.subject_id = p.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND l.itemid = 11175550 AND l.charttime <= l.storetime;
